paragraphs.text: The new walk goes around two existing planters. Include the joint detail shown in the small works sketch.
There is an expansion joint at each planter interface. A supplier brochure also shows decorative scoring, but the owner has not requested decorative bands.
The caretaker has spare garden edging; it is not proposed as concrete joint filler.
Approve expansion joints with 13 mm filler at the two planter interfaces, held in place during finishing. Ordinary transverse broom finish elsewhere. No decorative scoring bands.
Provide 13 mm expansion-joint filler at both planter interfaces and secure it during finishing; transverse broom finish elsewhere. Decorative bands excluded.
